tools.name: grandet_resolve_model
tools.description: Look up public model identifiers when a requested name is ambiguous. Results are a page of candidates, not a cheapest-provider ranking. Prefer an exact officialId match; do not silently substitute a different model generation.

tools.name: grandet_quote_evidence
tools.description: Read one provider's paged public declarations for a model and optional rowId. Use only when a detail matters, not before every recommendation. A missing row on one page is not proof of absence; follow pagination if needed. This does not test model quality or spend money.

tools.name: grandet_glossary
tools.description: Look up the published Grandet relay glossary. Site labels are source claims and glossary terms explain them; they do not verify quality. Query q or category and follow pagination. Unknown terms include up to three related FAQ links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: grandet_find_cheapest_api · Private data: grandet_find_cheapest_api · Public sink: grandet_find_cheapest_api.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
